messages:
Maya (support): Customer reports 400 Invalid JSON in tool_args when calling tool.parse_file. They pasted their request body.
Ethan (sdk): Can you paste the raw request body?
Maya (support): Here it is (redacted):
```
{tool: parse_file, args: \"{path: C:/Users/Alice/data.txt, notes: First line\nSecond line, }\"}
```
Maya (support): API error: 400 - Unexpected token '}' at position ~128
Priya (eng-infra): Looks like double-stringified args + a trailing comma and an embedded newline inside the inner string. Parser chokes on the stray comma after Second line.
Ethan (sdk): Quick repro suggestion (curl):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{tool: parse_file, args: "{path: C:/Users/Alice/data.txt, notes: First line\nSecond line, }"}'
```
Priya (eng-infra): Reproduced locally, server returns 400. Root cause looks like SDK v0.8.1 helper double-encodes when payload contains raw newlines and treats objects as strings, which leaves trailing commas in place.
Ethan (sdk): Filed SDK PR to stop double-encoding and to add a linter that warns about trailing commas: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/245. Also improved our API error to call out "double-encoded tool args".
Priya (eng-infra): Short-term customer workaround: send args as a native JSON object (not a string) or explicitly escape internal newlines. Example payload that worked:
```
{tool: parse_file, args: {path: "C:/Users/Alice/data.txt", notes: "First line\nSecond line"}}
```
Maya (support): Sent the example to customer. They updated their request format and the call returned 200. Closing the ticket. :thumbsup:
SupportBot: Ticket #42812 closed by Maya (support).
